notes.title: V0.3.5 Update Notice.
notes.content: [h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where a defeated Monster interrupted the Hero’s attack animation—battles are now smoother.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected the gold icon display error during Moon Notification (Quick Hide) mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where an empty dialogue box appeared at the Altar after switching to the Sun Button in Quick Hide mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved a bug allowing Monster summoning during the Boss phase—now summoning is disabled during Boss fights.[/p][/*][/list][h3]New Optimizations[/h3][list][*][p]Sun/Moon Button (Quick Hide): Now auto-adjusts size based on game resolution.[/p][/*][*][p]The upgrade button of Decor becomes unclickable at max level, keeping the interface clean.[/p][/*][*][p]Sacrificing a Rare Hero (i.e., a shiny card in the Hero Collection) boosts the chance of hatching a Rare Hero from the egg.[/p][/*][*][p]Eggs with multiple genes (the four icons below age in the Hero info panel) now have a lower chance of hatching single-gene Heroes.[/p][/*][*][p]The Altar now has a rare chance to summon UR Heroes.[/p][/*][*][p]Healing clicks for Heroes increased to a max of 10 per second (up from 2), with adjusted healing amounts and improved Healing Tree efficiency.[/p][/*][/list]
